lines.en: label cafe40:
scene cafeotoha1
I walk into the cafe first thing in the morning to suddenly remember that I am not the only person of importance in Rin’s life.
lines.zh: 我一早走进咖啡馆，突然想起来，我并不是 Rin 生命里唯一重要的人。

lines.en: What a shitty way to start the day.
lines.zh: 这真是个糟糕的开头。

lines.en: if cafe35 == True:
Seated with her at the table appears to be the same girl we ran into at the park during her post-rejection blues.
lines.zh: 和她一起坐在桌边的，似乎就是她失恋低落期时我们在公园里遇见的那个女孩。

lines.en: else:
Seated with her at the table is a girl around the same age as her, likely the one who she couldn’t stop talking about during the Christmas party.
lines.zh: 和她一起坐在桌边的，是个和她年纪相仿的女孩，大概就是她在圣诞派对上念叨个不停的那位。

lines.en: The real question is whether or not I should leave the two of them alone or try to insert myself into the conversation.
lines.zh: 真正的问题在于，我是该留下她们两个独处，还是试着插进这段对话里。

lines.en: I think back to what seems like aeons ago when I ran into a similar situation, but with Chika at the table next to Rin instead of this new girl.
lines.zh: 我回想起仿佛很久很久以前，我遇到过一次类似的情形，只不过当时坐在 Rin 旁边的是 Chika，而不是这个新来的女孩。

lines.en: Back then, Rin was barely able to hold a conversation on account of how nervous she was.
lines.zh: 那时候，Rin 紧张得几乎连话都说不利索。

lines.en: So...if something like that is happening again today, surely she’d want me to step in.
lines.zh: 所以……如果今天又发生了类似的事，她肯定希望我插手吧。

lines.en: Right?
lines.zh: 对吧？

lines.en: Well-
Only one way to find out, I guess.
lines.zh: 看来只有一种办法能知道了。

lines.en: Time to, once again, involve myself in the daily lives of [high_school] girls and see where I’m able to fit in.
lines.zh: 是时候再一次把自己塞进 [high_school] 女生的日常生活里，看看自己能挤进哪块位置了。

lines.en: if cafe35 == False:
scene cafeotoha2
: Oh, Sensei! Good morning.
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei！早上好。

lines.en: : If you need anything, Haruka’s manning the counter right now.
lines.zh: : 你要什么的话，现在柜台是 Haruka 在看着。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : You’re Rin’s teacher?
lines.zh: : 你是 Rin 的老师？

lines.en: : You look younger than she made you sound.
lines.zh: : 你看起来比她说的要年轻。

lines.en: : ...How did she make me sound, exactly?
lines.zh: : ……她具体是怎么说我的？

lines.en: scene cafeotoha3
: I have no idea what Otoha’s talking about.
lines.zh: : 我不知道 Otoha 在说什么。

lines.en: : I totally didn’t say anything about the gigantic age gap between us and about how you’re way too comfortable around [teenage]girls.
lines.zh: : 我可绝对没说过我们之间那道巨大的年龄差距，也没说过你跟[teenage]女孩待在一起时有多自在。

lines.en: : Yeah, you walked right up to us. Show some restraint, dude.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你就这么直接走过来了。克制点啊，老兄。

lines.en: : Yeah, Sensei. Show some restraint.
lines.zh: : 就是啊，Sensei。克制点。

lines.en: Why am I being ganged up on before I’ve even had the chance to do anything?
lines.zh: 我还没来得及干什么呢，怎么就被围攻了？

lines.en: else:
scene cafeotoha4
: Oh, Sensei! Good morning!
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei！早上好！

lines.en: : Hey, it’s that guy from the park who hangs out with [teenager]s.
lines.zh: : 嘿，是公园里那个跟 [teenager] 混在一起的家伙。

lines.en: : I liked Rin’s greeting more.
lines.zh: : 我更喜欢 Rin 的打招呼方式。

lines.en: : Good morning, you two.
lines.zh: : 早上好，你们两个。

lines.en: : If you need anything, Haruka is manning the counter right now.
lines.zh: : 你要什么的话，现在柜台是 Haruka 在看着。

lines.en: : If not, you’re free to chill with us, though.
lines.zh: : 如果没有的话，你也可以跟我们一块儿待着。

lines.en: : Or both. You’re not limited to just one of those two things.
lines.zh: : 或者两样都来。又没规定你只能选一样。

lines.en: : I’d probably prefer it if you’d buy something. Otherwise it seems like you just came here to hang out with Rin.
lines.zh: : 我还是更希望你能买点什么。不然看起来就像你只是来找 Rin 的一样。

lines.en: scene cafeotoha5
: Oh, he probably did. He does that a lot.
lines.zh: : 哦，他八成就是。他经常这样。

lines.en: : Stop saying things that give her a bad first impression of me.
lines.zh: : 别再说那些让她对我第一印象变差的话了。

lines.en: scene cafeotoha6
: {i}Second{/i} impression, Sensei. The first impression was when you were hanging out with Futaba and me in the park.
lines.zh: : 是{i}第二{/i}印象了，Sensei。第一印象是你在公园里跟我和 Futaba 混在一起的时候。

lines.en: : Besides, we’re pals. I love that you come here to hang out.
lines.zh: : 再说，我们是哥们儿。你过来找我玩，我可高兴了。

lines.en: : I still think it’s weird. But it is what it is, I guess. You do you, man.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得挺怪的。不过事实就是这样吧。随你便，老兄。

lines.en: : ...That aside, isn’t it too early for you to just be hanging out at a table instead of working?
lines.zh: : ……先不说这个，现在离上班还早，你不是该干活吗，怎么就坐在桌边了？

lines.en: scene cafeotoha7
: Normally, yeah. But I’m taking my break a little early since this is the only time Otoha is able to show up today.
lines.zh: : 平时是没错。不过我把休息提前了，因为今天 Otoha 只有这个时间能来。

lines.en: scene cafeotoha8
: Wait, you’re doing this for {i}me{/i}? Dude, how much longer is your shift after this?
lines.zh: : 等等，你是为了{i}我{/i}？老兄，你这班还要上多久？

lines.en: : Like another seven hours or something. But it’s cool. I don’t need a break.
lines.zh: : 大概还有七个小时什么的。不过没关系。我不需要休息。

lines.en: : I can drink coffee whenever I want, so I’ll just run on that until I collapse or something.
lines.zh: : 我想喝咖啡随时都能喝，所以就靠咖啡撑到倒下为止呗。

lines.en: scene cafeotoha9
: Well shit, man. Now I feel really bad.
lines.zh: : 靠，老兄。这下我真的过意不去了。

lines.en: : I told you, it’s fine. I really don’t mind.
lines.zh: : 我说了，没关系的。我真的不介意。

lines.en: : What kind of life do you lead where nine in the morning is the only time you have to stop at a cafe?
lines.zh: : 你过的是什么样的生活啊，早上九点居然是唯一能来咖啡馆坐坐的时间？

lines.en: scene cafeotoha10
: I live pretty much as far away from this side of town as possible, so it’s kind of a journey every time I need to come down.
lines.zh: : 我家离这一带几乎是全城最远的地方，所以每次过来都算是一趟远征。

lines.en: : Otoha takes vocal lessons in some sketchy girl’s basement not far from here.
lines.zh: : Otoha 在不远处某个可疑女孩的地下室里上声乐课。

lines.en: : She’s not sketchy...she’s a professional musician.
lines.zh: : 她才不可疑……她是职业音乐人。

lines.en: : She just has a really sketchy basement. I saw pictures.
lines.zh: : 她只是有个特别可疑的地下室。我看过照片。

lines.en: : Yeah, that much is definitely true.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这一点倒是一点不假。

lines.en: : She’s been a big help, though. I can’t imagine where I’d be without her.
lines.zh: : 不过她帮了我很多。真不敢想象没有她我会变成什么样。

lines.en: if cafe35 == True:
: Right, you’re a musician.
lines.zh: : 对，你是音乐人。

lines.en: : Still playing in that park we found you at?
lines.zh: : 还在我们找到你的那个公园里弹吗？

lines.en: else:
: You’re a musician?
lines.zh: : 你是音乐人？

lines.en: : Yup! Just like Rin here.
lines.zh: : 对！跟 Rin 一样。

lines.en: : Otoha is a million times better than me and I could never hope to achieve even an ounce of her talent or beauty.
lines.zh: : Otoha 比我厉害一百万倍，她的才华和美貌，我一丁点都望尘莫及。

lines.en: : Also, I didn’t just mention her beauty. Forget that happened.
lines.zh: : 还有，我可没提到她的美貌。当我没说。

lines.en: : Really, though. She’s so pretty.
lines.zh: : 不过说真的，她真的好漂亮。

lines.en: : Please excuse Rin. She talks a little too much when she gets nervous.
lines.zh: : 请原谅 Rin。她一紧张话就特别多。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s one of the first things I realized about her. I just ignore it at this point.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这可是我最早发现的特点之一。现在我直接当没听见。

lines.en: : Otoha used to play mini concerts every weekend at some park in the area Futaba and I used to live in.
lines.zh: : Otoha 以前每周末都会在我和 Futaba 以前住的那片区域的某个公园里办小型演出。

lines.en: : That’s how I met her.
lines.zh: : 我就是那么认识她的。

lines.en: : Used to?
lines.zh: : 以前？

lines.en: scene cafeotoha11
: Had to stop since I’ve been really busy lately.
lines.zh: : 最近实在太忙，不得不停了。

lines.en: : After my[school] sunk into the ground out of nowhere, I started being homeschooled instead.
lines.zh: : 我那所[school]莫名其妙沉进地里之后，我就改成在家上学了。

lines.en: : And, weirdly enough, it’s actually a little harder being homeschooled than it is going to actual[school].
lines.zh: : 说来奇怪，在家上学居然比去真正的[school]还难一点。

lines.en: : Yeah, I honestly can’t imagine anything easier than being in my class.
lines.zh: : 是啊，说真的，我想不出有什么比上我的课更轻松的了。

lines.en: : Sensei hasn’t given us a single assignment in months. It’s awesome.
lines.zh: : Sensei 已经好几个月没给我们布置过一次作业了。爽死了。

lines.en: : I’m lucky if I can go a day without some ridiculous assignment.
lines.zh: : 我要是能有一天没有那种离谱的作业，就算运气好了。

lines.en: : My parents are super strict about my education now that I’m not in[school] anymore.
lines.zh: : 我现在不上[school]了，我爸妈对我的教育管得特别严。

lines.en: scene cafeotoha12
: I’ve been trying to convince her to transfer into our[school] but she feels weird about moving into the dorms without having a roommate.
lines.zh: : 我一直劝她转到我们[school]来，可她觉得没有室友就搬进宿舍怪怪的。

lines.en: : Can’t she just stay in your room?
lines.zh: : 她不能就住你房间吗？

lines.en: : I mean...I think there’s a rule about having no more than two girls in one room-
lines.zh: : 嗯……我记得有规定说一个房间不能超过两个女生——

lines.en: scene cafeotoha13
: Unless...we slept in the same bed and no one ever found out about it...
lines.zh: : 除非……我们睡同一张床，而永远没人发现……

lines.en: : You good?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: scene cafeotoha14
: Huh?
: Where am I right now?
lines.zh: : 我现在在哪儿？

lines.en: : So, you’re only in this part of town so you can go hang out and sing in some sketchy girl’s basement?
lines.zh: : 所以，你跑到这一带来，就为了去某个可疑女孩的地下室里唱歌？

lines.en: : Some girl’s sketchy basement. Slightly different, but you get the gist.
lines.zh: : 是某个女孩的可疑地下室。稍微有点不一样，不过意思你懂就行。

lines.en: : Rin and I have been talking a lot ever since bumping into each other in the park, but I don’t really have a lot of time to ever hang out or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 自从在公园偶遇之后，我和 Rin 一直在聊，可我实在没什么时间出来玩什么的。

lines.en: : So the only chances we have to meet up involve me getting up mad early and sacrificing sleep in the name of friendship.
lines.zh: : 所以我们唯一能见面的机会，就是我起个大早，以友谊之名牺牲睡眠。

lines.en: scene cafeotoha15
: She’s awesome, right?! Coming all the way over here just to see me!
lines.zh: : 她是不是很棒？！大老远跑过来就为了见我！

lines.en: : It’s not that big of a deal...
lines.zh: : 没那么夸张啦……

lines.en: : But yeah, I guess I can be kind of awesome at times.
lines.zh: : 不过是啊，我想我有时候确实挺棒的。

lines.en: : I come here to see you all the time.
lines.zh: : 我也经常来这儿看你啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, but I see you so much that I’m starting to become immune.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可我见你见得太多了，都快免疫了。

lines.en: : Can you...become immune to people?
lines.zh: : 人……是能免疫的吗？

lines.en: : Of course!
lines.zh: : 当然能！

lines.en: scene cafeotoha16
: You two really spend {i}that{/i} much time together, huh?
lines.zh: : 你们俩真的待在一起{i}那么{/i}久吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but he’s only seen my boobs like once or twice so we’re probably not as close as you think we are.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过他也就看过我胸部一两次，所以我们大概没你想的那么亲密。

lines.en: : Why would you even say that?
lines.zh: : 你干嘛要说这个？

lines.en: : Say what? What did I say?
lines.zh: : 说什么？我说什么了？

lines.en: : I literally can’t remember. Am I having a stroke?
lines.zh: : 我真的想不起来了。我是不是中风了？

lines.en: : I’m just going to pretend I didn’t hear that, so don’t even worry about it.
lines.zh: : 我就当没听见好了，你别放心上。

lines.en: Good. I guess this Otoha girl is just as cool as she looks.
lines.zh: 很好。看来这个 Otoha 跟她的外表一样酷。

lines.en: Which is pretty damn cool, not gonna lie.
lines.zh: 而且老实说，酷得要命。

lines.en: Do you see how many rings she’s wearing?
lines.zh: 你看到她戴了多少戒指吗？

lines.en: scene cafeotoha17
: Hey, umm...you wouldn’t happen to have any free time tonight or something would you?
lines.zh: : 那个，嗯……你今晚之类的有空吗？

lines.en: : It’s like...the weekend and stuff, so I can’t imagine your parents are making you study all day today.
lines.zh: : 毕竟是……周末什么的，我想你爸妈总不至于让你学一整天吧。

lines.en: : I might have some free time later on but like, I don’t really have the money to afford another bus trip.
lines.zh: : 我晚点大概有空，不过我实在没钱再坐一趟巴士了。

lines.en: : Maybe we could meet halfway? Like, walk around the mall for a little while or something?
lines.zh: : 要不我们折中一下？比如去商场逛一会儿什么的？

lines.en: : Uhhhhhhhhhh...or literally anywhere else. Malls are weird anyway. Like, who likes malls?
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃呃……或者随便别的什么地方都行。商场本来就怪怪的。谁会喜欢商场啊？

lines.en: : What? I like malls. Plenty of people like malls.
lines.zh: : 什么？我喜欢商场。喜欢商场的人多的是。

lines.en: : Yeah but like...there are so many...fluorescent lights and...shoe stores...
lines.zh: : 是啦，可是那里有太多……日光灯，还有……鞋店……

lines.en: : Chika doesn’t normally work nights if that’s what you’re worried about.
lines.zh: : 如果你担心的是这个的话，Chika 一般不上夜班。

lines.en: scene cafeotoha18
: Dad! Are you {i}trying{/i} to embarrass me?!
lines.zh: : 爸！你是{i}故意{/i}要让我难堪吗？！

lines.en: : ...Did you just call me Dad?
lines.zh: : ……你刚叫我爸？

lines.en: : I definitely heard her call you Dad.
lines.zh: : 我确实听见她叫你爸了。

lines.en: : Yes! Because you’re doing a really “Dad” thing right now!
lines.zh: : 对！因为你现在的所作所为实在太「爸」了！

lines.en: : So uhh...who's this Chika person anyway?
lines.zh: : 那个……话说回来，这个 Chika 是谁啊？

lines.en: scene cafeotoha20
: Her.
: How did you pull up a picture of her that quickly?
lines.zh: : 你怎么这么快就翻出她的照片来了？

lines.en: : Also, where did your phone even come from?
lines.zh: : 还有，你手机到底从哪儿冒出来的？

lines.en: : Don’t ask questions you don’t want to hear the answers to, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 别问你不想听答案的问题，Sensei。

lines.en: : But...I {i}do{/i} want to hear the answers.
lines.zh: : 可我{i}确实{/i}想听答案。

lines.en: : She’s hot.
lines.zh: : 她好辣。

lines.en: : Painfully so.
lines.zh: : 辣得要命。

lines.en: scene cafeotoha21
: Why’s one person keeping you away from the mall, though? I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 不过为什么一个人就能让你不去商场？我不懂。

lines.en: : Well...she’s not {i}keeping{/i} me away...
lines.zh: : 嗯……她不是在{i}逼{/i}我不去……

lines.en: : I’m...distancing myself for...personal reasons.
lines.zh: : 我是……因为……个人的原因在疏远她。

lines.en: scene cafeotoha22
: Care to elaborate since you seem to actually understand Rin?
lines.zh: : 你好像挺懂 Rin 的，要不你来讲讲？

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
: I’m sure he’d be {i}thrilled{/i} to tell you all about it considering he played such a big role in everything that went down.
lines.zh: : 考虑到他在整件事里扮演了那么重要的角色，他{i}肯定{/i}会很乐意跟你讲清楚的。

lines.en: : I...should probably stay out of this, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话……这件事我大概还是别掺和为好。

lines.en: : But...you’re literally the one who brought it up.
lines.zh: : 可是……明明就是你先提起的啊。

lines.en: else:
: Leave my dad out of this.
lines.zh: : 别把我爸扯进来。

lines.en: : As much as I’d love to explain things to you, it would probably be best if Rin told you herself.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很想跟你解释，不过最好还是让 Rin 自己告诉你。

lines.en: : Yeah...it doesn’t look like that’s going to happen.
lines.zh: : 嗯……看样子是不太可能了。

lines.en: : Not yet. I need time to prepare.
lines.zh: : 现在还不行。我需要时间准备。

lines.en: : And to...delete pictures.
lines.zh: : 还要……删照片。

lines.en: scene cafeotoha23
: But...um, since I don’t want to go to the mall, maybe I could just come over to...your place or something?
lines.zh: : 不过……嗯，既然我不想去商场，那我能不能去……你家什么的？

lines.en: : I have some extra money for the bus and I {i}kind of{/i} know my way around that part of town anyway, so...I could just stop by tonight?
lines.zh: : 我有坐巴士的余钱，而且那一带我{i}也算{/i}认得路，所以……我今晚就能过去？

lines.en: : That’s sweet, but you don’t have to do that. It’s a crazy long trip to make that late at night.
lines.zh: : 你这份心意很好，不过你不用这样。那么晚跑那么远太夸张了。

lines.en: : My house is kind of boring anyway, so I can’t imagine it would be any fun.
lines.zh: : 我家也挺无聊的，我想你去也不会好玩。

lines.en: : How about you just text me tonight and we try to make plans sometime in the future?
lines.zh: : 要不你今晚给我发短信，我们改天再约？

lines.en: : Does that work?
lines.zh: : 这样行吗？

lines.en: scene cafeotoha24
: Y-Yeah! Totally.
lines.zh: : 当、当然！完全没问题。

lines.en: : I’ll text you all day and make like, all of the plans ever.
lines.zh: : 我会给你发一整天的短信，把所有能约的都约一遍。

lines.en: : Um...I mean, if you want to text me all day that’s fine. But I don’t think I’ll be able to respond right away a lot of the time.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我的意思是，你想给我发一整天当然没问题。不过很多时候我大概没法马上回。

lines.en: : I will do my best to not think you hate me if you take too long to reply.
lines.zh: : 如果你回得慢，我会尽量不觉得你讨厌我。

lines.en: : Hey, if that’s what makes you happy...
lines.zh: : 嘿，只要你开心就好……

lines.en: : I’ve gotta get a move on, though. There’s a sketchy basement with my name on it and drinking caffeine before singing really isn’t a great idea anyway.
lines.zh: : 不过我得走了。有个写着我的名字的可疑地下室在等我，而且唱歌前摄入咖啡因确实不是什么好主意。

lines.en: : Yeah, totally! That’s a thing I definitely knew!
lines.zh: : 对对对！这个我当然知道！

lines.en: : Um...have fun in the basement!
lines.zh: : 嗯……祝你在地下室玩得开心！

lines.en: : Yeah. I will...do just that.
lines.zh: : 好。我会的……就那么做。

lines.en: : Bye, Rin.
lines.zh: : 拜拜，Rin。

lines.en: scene cafeotoha25
: And see you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 还有，回头见，Sensei。

lines.en: : Thanks for only moderately creeping up the place this morning.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你今早只是把气氛弄得中等程度的诡异。

lines.en: : That’s what I’m here for.
lines.zh: : 这就是我的职责。

lines.en: : Wild.
lines.zh: : 够野。

lines.en: scene cafeotoha26
Otoha grabs her cup of coffee off the table and chugs the entire thing down despite how bad caffeine apparently is before singing.
lines.zh: Otoha 从桌上抓起自己的咖啡一饮而尽，尽管她说唱歌前摄入咖啡因有多糟。

lines.en: Which is also a thing I definitely knew.
lines.zh: 这也是我当然知道的事。

lines.en: And Rin is now beaming with so much excitement and energy that she doesn’t even feel the need to bring up Chika.
lines.zh: 而此刻的 Rin 兴奋得容光焕发、能量满满，甚至都觉得没必要再提 Chika 了。

lines.en: : Why the ever-living fuck did you bring up Chika?
lines.zh: : 你他妈到底为什么要提 Chika？

lines.en: Oh. Nevermind, I guess.
lines.zh: 哦。看来当我没说。

lines.en: : Your expression really does not match your tone right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在的表情和语气可真是不搭。

lines.en: scene cafeotoha27
: No, like really, though! Why did you do that?!
lines.zh: : 不是，我是认真的！你为什么要那么做？！

lines.en: : You totally knew why I didn’t want to go to the mall and you brought it up anyway.
lines.zh: : 你明明知道我为什么不想去商场，却还是提了。

lines.en: : And don’t say it’s because you’re my dad and you were trying to embarrass me!
lines.zh: : 还有，别说是因为你是我爸、想让我难堪！

lines.en: : Yeah, that is definitely not a thing I was going to say. Stop calling me your dad.
lines.zh: : 对，这绝对不是我要说的话。别再叫我爸了。

lines.en: : Fine! Then why were you being such a bad homie?
lines.zh: : 行吧！那你干嘛这么不够意思？

lines.en: : I’m just now starting to get over Chika and every time I hear her name it adds like one more week to the time it will take for that to happen.
lines.zh: : 我好不容易才开始放下 Chika，可每次听到她的名字，要走出来就得多花一个星期。

lines.en: : And now I’ve just added another week. Thanks a lot, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 现在我又多加了一个星期。多谢你了，Sensei。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I guess seeing you with Otoha made me feel like you were a little closer to being over her.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。大概是看到你跟 Otoha 在一起，让我觉得你离放下她又近了一点。

lines.en: : Dude, Otoha doesn’t even know I’m bi yet.
lines.zh: : 老兄，Otoha 还不知道我是双性恋呢。

lines.en: : I am...pretty sure she does.
lines.zh: : 我……挺确定她知道的。

lines.en: : But I do such an awesome job hiding it!
lines.zh: : 可我藏得那么好啊！

lines.en: : What?! Why are you being so quiet all of a sudden?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！你怎么突然不说话了？！

lines.en: : You literally told her that you wanted her to sleep in your bed and that she was beautiful like five minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 你五分钟前才刚跟她说想让她睡你的床，还说她很漂亮。

lines.en: scene cafeotoha28
: That actually happened?!
lines.zh: : 那真的发生了？！

lines.en: : I thought that was just in my head!
lines.zh: : 我还以为那只是在我脑子里说的！

lines.en: : It absolutely was not.
lines.zh: : 绝对不是。

lines.en: scene cafeotoha29
: I’m such a creep. Why do you even like me?
lines.zh: : 我真是个变态。你到底为什么喜欢我啊？

lines.en: : Probably because I’m a creep, too.
lines.zh: : 大概因为我也是个变态吧。

lines.en: : You really are. You’re a total weirdo.
lines.zh: : 你确实是。你就是个彻头彻尾的怪人。

lines.en: : Remind me to never flash you again.
lines.zh: : 提醒我以后别再对你露了。

lines.en: : Absolutely not. I embrace all future flashing.
lines.zh: : 那可不行。我拥抱未来所有的露。

lines.en: : Dude, weird. You just told me you want me to flash you.
lines.zh: : 老兄，好恶心。你刚刚是在说你想让我露给你看。

lines.en: : Yes. I am not hiding that.
lines.zh: : 对。我可没在掩饰这一点。

lines.en: : Gross. Super gross. You’re the worst.
lines.zh: : 恶心。恶心死了。你最讨厌了。

lines.en: : Get out of here, Dad. And stop going through my underwear drawer while I’m at[school].
lines.zh: : 走开啦，爸。还有我上[school]的时候别再翻我内衣抽屉了。

lines.en: scene black
It isn’t long before Rin’s break comes to an end and I need to head back out into the street to find some other way to spend my time.
lines.zh: 没过多久，Rin 的休息就结束了，我也得回到街上，另找点事打发时间。

lines.en: Even though she gave me shit about it, I think it’s safe to assume that Rin isn’t actually mad at me.
lines.zh: 虽然她为这事儿数落了我一顿，但我大概可以放心地认为，Rin 并没有真的生我的气。

lines.en: But a lot of that is probably due to the fact that it didn’t backfire.
lines.zh: 不过这多半是因为那件事没闹出反效果。

lines.en: Her friend seems really chill. The two of them would make a good couple.
lines.zh: 她这位朋友看起来真的很随和。她们两个会很般配。

lines.en: So much so that I’m only mildly concerned about her becoming yet another barrier between Rin and me in the future.
lines.zh: 般配到我只是隐隐有点担心，她将来会成为挡在 Rin 和我之间的又一道障碍。

lines.en: $ cafe40 = True
$ rin_love += 1
{i}Your daughter, Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你的女儿，Rin 的好感度提升到了 [rin_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
